text.p: Gander Mountain Inc said it has received final approval from a U.S. bankruptcy judge for $25 million in debtor-in-possession financing, allowing the company to continue to do business.

The financing will be provided by CIT Group/Business Credit Inc of Chicago, the company said. The approval follows negotiations with the Official Unsecured Creditors Group Committee, held to resolve objections by the committee.
The company said it is pursuing other alternatives for raising additional equity.
Gander said it intends to continue its business. It said it has not yet filed a reorganization plan, but expects to do so in the near future.
Gander provides outdoor recreation clothing and equipment.
